item.title: Delayed Support Email Delivery to Microsoft 365 and Outlook Mailboxes
item.description:
Nov 14, 05:53 UTC
Resolved - This incident has been resolved.

Nov 13, 18:47 UTC
Monitoring - We are monitoring email delivery and will provide another update once delivery is back to normal.

Nov 13, 10:29 UTC
Identified - We are aware that some Netlify Support email responses to customers using Microsoft 365 and Outlook-hosted mailboxes are experiencing delivery delays.

These delays appear to be related to an ongoing Microsoft Exchange Online service disruption, with some messages being temporarily deferred by Microsoft's mail servers.

Our Support team continues to process and respond to tickets, but affected customers may experience delays receiving our replies.

We are monitoring email delivery and will provide an update as Microsoft's service recovers.

item.title: Increase in errors for drag and drop deploys
item.description:
Nov 12, 09:00 UTC
Resolved - Between 2026-11-12 09:00 UTC and 2026-11-13 17:27 UTC, a high number of drag and drop deploys were failing. The issue is now resolved.

item.title: Elevated build and deploy failures
item.description:
Nov 4, 17:21 UTC
Resolved - This incident has been resolved.

Nov 4, 17:15 UTC
Identified - We’ve identified an issue at 16:43 UTC that can cause some builds to fail while functions deploy. These affected builds can fail with a system error during the deploy step. Our team is adding capacity and working on a fix.
